# Generated by @farm.js/mobile/android on every farm dev|build --mobile. Do not edit.
#
# libappmodules.so: connects React Native's core Java TurboModules (PlatformConstants,
# Networking, ...) to JSI. React Native's prebuilt libraries load it by name and cannot find
# those modules without it; the React Native Gradle plugin builds the same library for RN apps.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(appmodules)

find_package(ReactAndroid REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(fbjni REQUIRED CONFIG)

add_library(appmodules SHARED OnLoad.cpp)

# The flags React Native's own app setup compiles with (folly and react-native flags).
target_compile_options(appmodules PRIVATE
  -fexceptions
  -frtti
  -std=c++20
  -DLOG_TAG=\"ReactNative\"
  -DFOLLY_NO_CONFIG=1
  -DFOLLY_HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME=1
  -DFOLLY_USE_LIBCPP=1
  -DFOLLY_CFG_NO_COROUTINES=1
  -DFOLLY_MOBILE=1
  -DFOLLY_HAVE_RECVMMSG=1
  -DFOLLY_HAVE_PTHREAD=1
  -DFOLLY_HAVE_XSI_STRERROR_R=1)
target_compile_definitions(appmodules PRIVATE RN_SERIALIZABLE_STATE HERMES_V1_ENABLED=1)

target_link_libraries(appmodules ReactAndroid::reactnative ReactAndroid::jsi fbjni::fbjni)
